title: The first thing to do with your bonus #Bonus
text:
An order that works for most people. One: pay off expensive debt. Credit and store cards can legally charge up to the repo rate plus 14 percentage points a year, over 20% right now. R6,000 on a store card at 20% a year is about R1,200 a year in interest, so paying it off is like earning 20%, guaranteed. Two: build your emergency fund, a few months of expenses you can reach quickly, so you don't borrow when the car breaks down or you lose your job in January.

Full guide: "Your Bonus or 13th Cheque: How It's Taxed and What to Do With It (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
